text: answer[salesreel-01c54fce]: A checkable job sales reel at these specs: keep runtime at or under 30 seconds, ideally 22-28s to leave headroom for platform trimming. Export 9:16 vertical (1080x1920 minimum, 2160x3840 for 4K) so it plays correctly in Reels, TikTok, Shorts, and LinkedIn mobile feeds. Encode as H.264 in an MP4 container, using high profile at roughly 8-12 Mbps, 30fps, with a silent or lightweight AAC audio track. Keep file size under 100MB. Structure: hook in the first 3 seconds, one problem, one solution, one concrete result or number, then a single call to action. On-screen captions throughout since many users watch muted. Deliver as one file matching exactly: .mp4, h264, 9:16, <=30s.
